**What type of PR is this?**  /kind feature  **What does this PR do / why do we need it**:  Review the Stop recovery and terminal settlement path across the Session Manager and Store packages. Store retains the first Stop operation, command, claim and receipt together. Manager reconciles that original record before sending B2c, including after reassembly. The M3 candidate accepts an independently observed original Stop and requires STOPPED evidence for an M1 stopped terminal. Store commits the terminal, publication obligation and operation receipt in one boundary. Late ordinary completion and failure are stale after Stop.  **Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:  Refs #2211 Refs #2212 Refs #2199 Refs #2113  **What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：  **Exact head `582be63433b0874d936d5b28fc2ff93ce257f7b4`** on `component/agent-service` `f8141f2f5`. The proposed optional Manager/Store M1 input carries the original partial answer and failure code. Store owns the outcome/revision and writes the frozen projection with the original receipt and publication. Lost acknowledgement reconciles by the same intent; changed text or code conflicts. A successful projection inconsistent with the accepted answer is rejected. Existing calls without this input preserve their previous behavior. The production Backend has not been wired to provide the content.  - Windows and WSL Python 3.12 ran 107 targeted Manager/Store/Backend cases each, with three existing expected failures. WSL passed the 78 contract-package tests and ran 1014 Agent Service tests with five existing expected failures. Candidate architecture scan reported zero violations and three existing file-size warnings. - Separate [publication combination](https://github.com/huben0423-hw/DigitalMate/commit/5217eb9f3def8517bc34ebec5f4c09940dc5f448) includes this head and #2263 `7201dea7d`. WSL ran 109 targeted cases and 1127 full Agent Service cases with four existing expected failures. It preserves the atomic publication allocator and exercises stopped/failed replay through Backend and MobileEgress with a controlled Gateway. - The M1 producer agreement, v1 design review, and production verification remain pending. Hosted CI and device/deployed integration were not run.   - Windows Python 3.12, exact PR head e972cd618: 75 focused Manager and Store tests passed. The implementation is identical to 786798604. On a clean WSL export of 786798604, 856 Agent Service tests passed and the architecture scanner reported zero findings. - Actual Manager, retaining in-memory Store, Backend and Host gate. The recovery test reassembles the Manager and Store facade and invokes the same original B2c identity twice. The Host gate closes and the controlled Harness sees one H3 cancel. Host Store neighbors and the Harness remain controlled fixtures. - Failure before Stop or terminal commit does not leave a partial fact. After a lost acknowledgement the original operation reconciles. Unknown and requested M3 observations, wrong original command and ordinary late failure do not settle a stopped terminal. Legacy Stop with missing original command stays UNKNOWN. - Exact head b7ea93c0d2e70e060d95defb86e36024d803884f on component/agent-service fb5925d49. Windows and WSL each ran 105 focused tests with five known expected failures. The #2304 repeated-Stop test now positively verifies original Stop recovery and a distinct M3 receipt. The test Harness provides the verified STOPPED fact and the actual Store M3 owner persists it. The original control receipt remains unchanged. - WSL exact export Agent Service suite ran 916 tests with five expected failures and one failure in the existing Harness channel fixed-time concurrency test. The test and channel sources match the integration branch. The fixed-time channel case passed in isolation and a second exact-export full run finished with five expected failures and no additional failures. Candidate policy has zero findings. The trusted integration policy reports two AR10 findings for the new terminal and stop-evidence owner paths and one AR01 finding for the new control-to-stop-evidence dependency. These runs do not establish hosted CI or production verification. - Design and independent review, production startup composition, disk recovery and the trusted M3 source remain pending. Backend abandoned/evidence-refused behavior and the distinct in-flight tool entry fence need their D6 review. Hosted CI and device/production verification are NOT_RUN. [Evidence and boundaries](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2211#issuecomment-7065865961).  **Current head `999928137`** on component `596432a42`. M3 validates the first recorded Stop command before seeking the observation. A later command under the same claim cannot create an evidence receipt. External authorization and Stop observation run outside the Store writer lock. M3 checks external authorization again and verifies the retained original command, claim and principal immediately before committing. The new tests cover revocation during authorization and observation, a lost Backend reply with original Stop recovery, and terminal receipt disclosure after authority changes.  Windows and exact-tree WSL each ran 116 focused tests with five existing expected failures. The WSL full Agent Service run completed 996 tests including five existing expected failures. Tested changed-line coverage is 212/233 (90.99%) against the integration base. Candidate architecture reported no violations and three legacy file-size warnings on the production-identical preceding commit `1e386f7e5`. An earlier Windows run hit one Host supplement timing assertion; focused reruns and the exact final suites completed without that failure.  Three legacy Bridge Stop/final tests passed on Windows and their code and tests match main. They cover original Stop after lost ACK, visible CANCELLING before a paused interrupt, and a prior final outcome winning over a late Stop. These are baseline observations. D6 abandoned and evidence-refused behavior, the production observer, disk recovery and the authoritative M1/A19 revision boundary remain pending. No hosted CI result is claimed.  **Exact head `9064fb2e6ab4b0eb0de95f6ea1bcac6bc6dc248f`** (component `f8141f2f5`). M3 now checks the Manager caller before delegating to Store and rechecks before returning a successful receipt. With separate Manager caller and Store owner authorization, a denied call does not reach Store. Revocation during the original observation prevents receipt disclosure. Restoring Manager caller access returns the same committed M3 receipt without obtaining another Stop observation. Store remains solely responsible for committing the evidence. Test authorization and the Stop observer are controlled substitutes.  Windows and WSL Python 3.12 each ran 140 scoped tests (3 existing expected failures). WSL exact export ran 1013 Agent Service tests (5 existing expected failures) and candidate architecture reported zero violations with three existing size warnings. Package/coverage and trusted-main figures above describe the preceding head. Hosted CI and deployment were not run. D6 and production observer ownership remain pending.  **Self-checklist**:（**Please check carefully,and mark an x in the [] brackets. We will review your completion status.**）  + - [ ] **Design**: Has the solution corresponding to the PR been reviewed by the Maintainer, and have all review comments been replied to and revised + - [ ] **Test**: Has the code in the PR been fully covered by UT/ST test cases, and have the newly added test cases been uploaded to the repository along with this PR or already uploaded. + - [x] **Verification**: Does the PR description contains a detailed description of the verification results regarding the achievement of the expected goals for the Feature, Refactor, and Bugfix to this PR. + - [ ] **Interface**: Does it involve changes to external interfaces? The corresponding changes have been approved by the interface review organization, and the annotation information for the API has been correctly refreshed. + - [ ] **Document**: Does it involve modifications to the official website documentation? If so, please submit the materials to the Doc repository in a timely manner.  ```text Lane: F Issue: #2211   RFC: #2113   ADR: n/a — no accepted architecture change in this draft Design: docs/assets/feature-design/agent-service-manager-stop-terminal-review-v1.pptx Spec: docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-session-manager-backend-ports-target.md Design review: BLOCKED — v1 approval pending; issue review https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2211#issuecomment-7044601613 IDs implemented: MST-D1, MST-D2, MST-S1, MST-S2, MST-S3, MST-C1, MST-C2, MST-T1, MST-T2, MST-T3; DSS-T11 commit and receipt recovery subset Tests: MST-T1 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_manager_stop_terminal.py, MST-T2 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_manager_stop_terminal.py, MST-T3 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_manager_stop_terminal.py, DSS-T11 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_store_control_terminal.py::test_terminal_commit_reply_loss_recovers_original_terminal_and_publication Source: main 3469f0345f202d0426e5ccbf99df5a4b9b4ce006 / component/agent-service f8141f2f5ae7b0da1f974fe3366d999c5130b09e / head 582be63433b0874d936d5b28fc2ff93ce257f7b4. Local Store/Manager owner-port assembly. Ownership: Session Store writes the retained outcome; Session Manager coordinates M1/M3 and original B2c recovery; #2211 and #2212 Placement: server/agent_service/session_store and server/agent_service/backend/session_manager; candidate manifest updated Transition: n/a — no production cutover in this draft Verification: Windows/WSL scope PASS (140 each, 3 existing expected failures); exact WSL Agent Service PASS (1013, 5 existing expected failures); candidate architecture PASS; package, trusted-main architecture, new-head coverage, hosted CI and deployment NOT_RUN. Self-review: DEV-01..DEV-15 considered; independent review, owner registration and production integration pending ```  **Stop, terminal, and supplement receipt commit results**  At d0779b11a41bfede35913f8323f7adb8d2898b28 on integration 6cae65e47f6da4e9bcf3fd486db7853522ce6ced, Store reports COMMIT_UNKNOWN when the commit is unconfirmed or its reply is lost. A failed Stop receipt commit leaves the claim unfenced. A failed terminal receipt commit leaves the Run state and publication log unchanged. A lost reply after terminal commit is reconciled against the original request, including the same publication ID. Supplement receipt and content index are committed together, and incomplete retained original evidence cannot be replaced as a new write. The five new tests fail with the prior production code at 999928137 and pass on the candidate.  Linux exact Git export: 150 focused tests with three existing expected failures, 1008 Agent Service tests with five existing expected failures, 78 package tests passed. Architecture checked 402 files, with zero violations and three existing size warnings. Windows Python 3.12: 103 focused tests passed. Coverage of changed production lines relative to integration was 229/252 (90.87%). An earlier run at 4d1751960 concurrent with package checks hit the unchanged fixed-time Harness channel test. The exact current candidate's sequential run passed aside from the listed expected failures. Hosted CI, deployed integration, durable cross-process authority, and v1 design and interface decisions remain pending.  ## Sync after #2312 and typed M1 denial  At 67d8ea1550cbe52c29f8ad9e298147b1ab5b1892 the draft includes integration f8141f2f5. The merge retains the Store authority/fence and prior Stop recovery tests. A definitive Store PermissionError on submit_terminal now returns DENIED without calling read_terminal. Test-only on the synced baseline 1111e85cf, the same refusal returned the old TerminalCommitted receipt. The genuine lost-ACK M1 control continues to reconcile by the original request and retains one publication. Tests run through actual Manager and Store owners with injected refusal/transport faults, retaining the in-process kernel. SQLite combination evidence remains in #2211 and #2212.  - Windows and WSL each ran 154 scoped tests with three existing expected failures. Exact WSL full Agent Service discovery ran 1012 tests with five existing expected failures. All 78 contract package tests passed. - Candidate architecture checked 402 files with zero violations and three existing size warnings. Using the main 3469f0345 trusted scanner and policy, integration has 16 existing findings and this candidate has 19. Its three additional findings are the two unenrolled owner paths for terminal.py and stop_evidence.py (AR10), plus the control-to-stop-evidence export edge (AR01). - Windows Python 3.12 standard-library trace on the same focused suite recorded 257 of 280 changed executable production lines (91.79%) against f8141f2f5. - The v1 verdict, formal STOPPED observer, D6 production ordering, trusted producer enrollment and deployed acceptance remain pending.    **Current head `9fdfc7da18298be55bd875da4d8c89aaab1bc6e6`:** incorporates component tip `ae9bd4f236d333505c00f92c07a066e81805adfe`. Manager rechecks caller authorization after Backend interrupt; if authorization is lost or the post-dispatch check raises, it withholds the result as COMMIT_UNKNOWN and later retries the original retained Stop command. A real Manager/Store regression with controlled Backend and authorization fails on the synced predecessor because it returns the Backend result after revocation, and passes on this head. Clean WSL Git archive with isolated Python 3.12 and repository source paths available to subprocesses: 1,078 Agent Service tests passed with five expected failures. Windows, package, architecture, coverage, hosted CI and production integration were not rerun. Production observer, durable Store, M1 producer agreement, independent design and owner review remain open; this PR remains draft.   **Current head `fea821293d45eb9a672eaf850f9455655c2f84a7`:** if the Stop write may have committed and authorization is subsequently lost, Manager returns COMMIT_UNKNOWN instead of a definite denial, and does not send Backend interrupt without current authority. After authorization returns the same retained command is dispatched. A real in-memory Store regression fails on previous head `9fdfc7da1` (DENIED after the actual write) and passes here. Explicit pre-write caller denial and typed Store refusals remain distinct. Clean WSL archive, isolated Python 3.12 with local repository sources available to subprocesses: 1,079 Agent Service tests passed with five expected failures. Windows, package, architecture, coverage, hosted CI and production integration were not rerun. Earlier stated draft/design, durable Store and production assembly limitations remain.   **Current head `8160c5c501ee9e5db77e0a7ef9ac3e07fe5bcfe7`:** adds an actual Store/Backend component test for answer-before-Stop: the committed original answer receipt remains readable and replayable, but after the Stop is committed and Backend interrupt finishes, responding returns STALE without sending a Harness answer. Existing answer-after-Stop coverage rejects the new write and returns STALE. The main baseline `3469f0345` task.answer path rejects cancelled tasks; these checks establish this ordering, not comprehensive concurrent or deployed equivalence. Clean WSL archive, isolated Python 3.12 with local repository sources available to subprocesses: 1,080 Agent Service tests passed with five expected failures. Windows, package, architecture, coverage, hosted CI and deployment were not rerun. Earlier design, durability and assembly caveats remain.    **F2 / integration follow-up:** exact head 121b84442c8157f8874d73dde99e1daa97b14f87 includes component 99770a15b. M1/M3 authorization refusal before a write remains DENIED; a permission error or revoked caller after a Store write has been attempted returns COMMIT_UNKNOWN and does not disclose a receipt. Regression covers a terminal committed then caller revoked, and original reconciliation after restored permission without a second publication; M3 tests cover pre-write denial and post-commit revocation. Current head remains draft; SQLite durable owner integration, production auth, hosted CI, architecture, and coverage were not run.   **M1 alignment proposal:** head f95870b6f2e846bb7f4a2397296a9700df69ce57 records the proposed answer/code request fields, separate context and authority revisions, no context append for failed/cancelled and A19 resulting head for completed, and one Store transaction for the outcome, receipt and publication. This documentation-only commit has identical runtime/test files to tested 121b84442 (1,230 Agent Service tests with 6 expected failures); not rerun at this head. F1 and durable production integration remain open.

## 变更

Nightly 的 ST job 失败时只打印 `ST failed; see summary.md and junit.xml.`；artifact 因配额缺失后，日志本身无法指出失败用例。本次只改测试报告层：

- `tests/st/report.mjs` 新增可导出的 `consoleSummary(report, compileOnly)`，命令行入口改用它。非 passed 时在首行后逐条输出 `<status> <name>/<coverageId> stage=<stage|unknown>: <detail>`；stage 未记录时显式标为 `unknown`，detail 压成单行并限长。
- 没有可打印的用例行（执行完整性失败、compile-only 等）时，回退输出 `no case result`、`report.stage` 与 issues。
- 通过时仍只输出原来的 `ST passed; ...`，退出码不变。

`scripts/run-digitalmate-device-st.ps1` 直接透传 `report.mjs` 的 stdout，无需改动；ST 用例、600s 超时预算和产品代码均未改。

## 覆盖与验证

`tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs` 新增两个回归：

- 直接断言摘要含 `skill_default_generation/SKL-01`、`stage=unknown`、detail，且不含已通过用例；另覆盖 blocked、通过、完整性失败、compile-only。
- 用真实 `tests/st/report.mjs` CLI 加临时 `source-manifest.json` / `device-result.json` 复现 artifact 缺失场景，断言退出码为 1 且 stdout 含失败用例名与 stage。

实际结果：

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs` → 38 pass / 0 fail。
- 合并运行 4 个 ST 相关单测文件 → 44 pass / 0 fail。
- 旧/新实现差分：旧 stdout 仅 `ST failed; see summary.md and junit.xml.`；新 stdout 追加 `failed skill_default_generation/SKL-01 stage=unknown: Case deadline exceeded at generate-documents; timeoutMs=600000`，两者退出码均为 1。
- 全量 `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs`：2910 pass / 41 fail。同一 41 项在未修改基线上以相同名称失败（本环境缺少 `typescript` 等依赖），非本改动引入。

## 分支与后续

本 PR 只面向 `main`。失败 run 位于 `release_v0.1.13`：该分支有 `tests/st/run-isolated.mjs`（`:30` 逐例执行，`:46` 只汇总 `Isolated ST failed`），而 `main` 没有该文件。release 上每用例的摘要由该分支自己的 `report.mjs` 产生，因此要让 Nightly 在 release 分支可定位，需要单独 backport 同样的摘要改动；本 PR 不假定会进入 release 分支。

SKL-01 的 600s 是否属于产品侧问题仍未证实：需按 job step summary 或 `ST_CASES=skill_default_generation` 定向重跑取得 stage 与失败分类后再判断。

Closes #2301

### 测试

```
node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs
```

由 agent 自报，平台未重跑。

2304.author: Jianyu010
2304.body:
Refs #755
Refs #756
Refs #2113

Tests only. No production file changes.

## What

47 system tests in `tests/server/agent_service/test_as_st_real_store_*.py` run the Backend (`run_coordinator`, `final`, `interaction`) against the real Session Store modules (`claims`, `control`, `tool_plans`) over one in-memory owner kernel. `real_store_rig.py` builds the rig; each test docstring says what is real and what is still a stand-in.

- **Start and terminal (#755):** one H1 for concurrent and duplicate starts, refusals before start, retry after unknown outcomes, sole final writer, replay after a lost acknowledgement, Stop-first.
- **Stop and answers (#756):** Stop fences the claim and closes the gate before H3, duplicate receipts replay, conflicting content is refused, an answer resumes once, and no continuation is fabricated after a Store restart.
- **Idempotency:** claim, terminal and tool-plan replay, including after a restart.

## Mismatches found (6 `expectedFailure` tests)

1. `check_claim`, `enter_run` and `register_question` are plain `def` in the Store, while `host_ports.py` declares them `async def`.
2. The Backend sends the session context revision as the terminal's `expected_revision`; the Store compares it with the Run state revision.
3. The Store writes the question event nested under `question`; `final` reads `interaction_id` at the top level, so the question event is not published.
4. A second Stop command overwrites `stop_evidence_ref`, so the first command's receipt no longer matches and the terminal never commits.
5. The Store has no `claim_delivery`, `commit_consumption`, `read_publications`, `read_unpublished`, `mark_published` or `reject_open_questions`.

Which side changes for each is to be agreed on #2113.

## Local gate (no CI runs on this base)

- `tests/server/agent_service`: 908 passed, 6 expected failures.
- Architecture scanner: clean.

2307.author: Jianyu010
2307.body:
Refs #754
Refs #758
Refs #2113

Ports behaviour of the old Bee tool gate (`bee_effects.py`) and the old per-action deadlines (`engine_tools_mcp.py` `call_deadline`) into the HostAPI tool path. Everything stays behind `enabled = false`; the deployed entry is unchanged.

## What is ported

- **Read-only readers:** answered without a Store plan, with the old refusal classes and texts and the old constructor checks. A read still passes the selection check, the hooks, the supplement hold and the claim check, before the read and again before disclosure.
- **`discover_tools`:** the old catalog filter runs on the Host side over a raw listing (Bee tool, enabled, listed for the Host, not forbidden by name or prefix; empty description when the handler has none). Switched by `[host.discovery]`, shipped off.
- **`call_goal` stripping**, with the argument size limit measured on the raw arguments as before.
- **Per-tool deadlines** from `[host.tool_deadlines]`, with the old extension rules.
- **Old test cases** carried into `test_as_hostapi_reads.py` and `test_as_hostapi_deadlines.py`.

Decision AS-I13 records why readers run on the Host side and not as Plugin Gateway providers, and lists each deliberate difference from the old gate.

## Not carried yet (recorded in ledger rows 15, 31, 32, 48)

- No reader implementation and no tool-listing source exist on the `server/` side: the Registry catalog and the Run selection hold only implementation references, with no enabled flag, listing class, forbidden lists or descriptions. Discovery therefore cannot be switched on yet.
- The deadline tables ship empty, because the old rules were keyed on bridge actions that are not Plugin Gateway tools yet. The old values are written beside the keys.
- A refused read is a tool message with the old text; a structured refusal marker needs a contract change on the tool reply.

## Review

An independent review found seven points; all are addressed in this branch with a failing test first, except the refusal marker above. In particular: an async read is cancelled at its deadline, a blocking read stays a tracked operation of its Run and abandoned reads are capped per Run, a reader deadline cannot exceed `[host.reads] max_read_seconds`, and `backend.settle_wait_seconds` must cover the longest configured tool deadline.

## Local gate (no CI runs on this base)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/server/agent_service` | 977 passed, 6 expected failures (the Store mismatches from #2304) |
| Architecture scanner | clean (394 of 636 files) |
| `test_contract_package.py`, `test_a02_enrollment.py`, `test_a14_contract_enrollment.py` | 91 passed |

2309.author: Jianyu010
2309.body:
Refs #761
Refs #765
Refs #799
Refs #2113

The normal Beebou loop ran inside the old Host. This adds the first real Harness process: the existing loop (`normal.py`, `quick.py`) runs unchanged as a child process whose only I/O is the Harness channel. Everything stays behind `enabled = false`; nothing on the deployed path registers it.

## What is ported

| Old (Host side) | New (Harness side, `temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/harness/`) |
|---|---|
| Loop construction in `hive_turn_startup.py` | `process_entry.py`, `host_channel.py` |
| `_BeebouModel` role and capability-facts injection | `model.py` `RoleModel`; text pinned to the old literal by a test |
| `HiveBeebouModel`, `LengthRecovery`, `budget_exhausted`, per-call metric | `model.py` `BeebouModel` |
| `QuickToolGate`, `SecondQuickToolGate`, execution journal, per-execution deadlines | `grants.py` |
| `beebou_capability_facts` catalog fallback | `capabilities.py` |
| Tool-error cap | `tool_guard.py` |

Tunables are in `config/process_entry.toml`.

## Contract change

`ModelsCall.parameters` (default empty). A frame without the field still decodes. The Host accepts only the keys in `[host] model_parameter_keys` (shipped: `reasoning_effort`); any other key, including budget keys, answers `BAD_INPUT` with nothing dispatched.

## Not carried (ledger rows 33-36, 46; decision AS-I14)

- **Per-request `max_tokens`:** the Model Gateway owns the budget, so the quick paths' smaller budget needs a second model provider.
- **Usage and prefix-cache log:** H5 replies carry no usage.
- **Per-Run Host data:** tool schemas and capability facts are read from H1 input keys that nothing writes yet; a normal Run without the tool list fails at once.
- **Facts per model call:** they arrive once per Run.
- **Tool errors:** the channel cannot tell a refusal before execution from a failure after it, so every tool error is reported to the model as "effect unknown"; an unknown outcome ends the Run with `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, which the Backend must treat as "reconcile".
- **Quick-reply orchestration** (when the quick executions run, their publication) has no owner in the new design.
- **Not declared by the entry:** supplements, progress streaming, questions, checkpoints, cancel settlement.

## Review

An independent review found ten points; all are fixed with a failing test first, except an asynchronous `ACCEPTED` dispatch not counting as a handoff (it carries no message or task reference; recorded in the ledger).

## Local gate (no CI runs on this base)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/server/agent_service` | 983 passed, 6 expected failures (Store mismatches from #2304) |
| `temp/hive-beebou/tests`, unittest discovery (`test_beebou_*.py`) | 166 passed (96 before) |
| `temp/hive-beebou/tests`, pytest | 315 passed, 53 subtests |
| Architecture scanner | clean (400 of 642 files) |
| `test_contract_package.py`, `test_a02_enrollment.py`, `test_a14_contract_enrollment.py` | 91 passed |

The system test `test_as_st_t10_beebou_process.py` launches the real child through the supervisor and runs one tool-pair turn.

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Commit a Run claim and its original receipt together in the existing Session Store owner kernel. Before the fix, a failed receipt commit could leave a live claim and a claimed revision with no original receipt. The identical request then returned STALE. A lost acknowledgement now returns typed COMMIT_UNKNOWN, and the original request can read back the committed claim. The write uses the existing Store lock and preserves the original scope, comparison and receipt format. This prepares the claim boundary for durable recovery using the same Store owner. The default-off in-memory assembly remains as it was, so cross-process persistence is still pending.

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Session Store persisted the owner and fence revision in each current Run authority, but the claim and control checks compared only the Run ID, claim reference and generation. An altered authority could still be reported as current or record a Stop. The existing claim/enter, control and supplement binding surfaces compare the complete stored authority. A new binding requires the current claim. Replaying a successful binding requires the original retained claim, so the original remains readable after Stop or reopening. The Store uses the existing representation, writer, statuses and signatures.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #2202, #2203, #2113 and #2110. This is the Store-local fence check described in the [routing note](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2202#issuecomment-7071575850).

- Candidate `3559aa32b8638a6d41e8403c54f09e7e4d5eb2eb`: Windows Python 3.12 ran 73 Store claim/control tests. The real owner ports reject altered owner and fence evidence. The valid original receipt remains readable after reopening the retained in-memory kernel, the original claim can enter, and a valid Stop can still commit after the stale Stop is rejected.
- Exact WSL Git archive: 992 Agent Service tests ran with six existing expected failures. Architecture scan checked 400 files, found zero violations and emitted three existing size warnings. All 78 contract-package profile tests passed.

**What type of PR is this?**  /kind bug  **What does this PR do / why do we need it**:  Session Manager rechecks caller scope before returning admission, claim or start observations. This uses the existing Manager authorization callback and owning Store/Backend operations.  **Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:  Refs #2210 Refs #2199 Refs #2113  **What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：  - On component baseline `f8141f2f5ae7b0da1f974fe3366d999c5130b09e` with the two new tests, a real SQLite admission commit and a real lookup each returned the original admitted Run after controlled caller revocation. Both regression assertions failed. - On exact head `b6e03862ab851aa59a6393056f7043344cfae830`, both paths return `SCOPE_DENIED`. Candidate architecture scan had zero violations and three existing file-size warnings. Hosted CI, packaging and deployment were not run. - Real participants are the Manager coordinator and SQLite Store. The revocation clock is a test-controlled callback. The broader suite contains controlled Host/Harness participants.  **F1/F2 follow-up at exact head `19e444f33c186104c932c45259248cbc240c953b`**. Authority loss before invoking the owner remains a definite scope refusal. If authorization changes after Store admission/readback, claim write/reconfirmation or Backend start, Manager returns a non-disclosing typed unknown and preserves the original reconciliation identity. A read of the admitted Run is rechecked before deriving a Registry compatibility outcome. A Store commit with lost ACK during revocation also remains unknown. The original SQLite admission and retained claim are recoverable after authorization is restored, and original B1 retry observes ALREADY_STARTED with a single H1.  The previous-head results above are historical. On `b6e03862` with the current tests, seven regression assertions fail. On this head, Windows and exact-export WSL each passed 71 Manager tests. WSL Agent Service full ran 999 tests, with six existing expected failures. Architecture passed with three existing size warnings. Policy changes are controlled in tests; Store admission uses real SQLite, claims use the Store in-memory owner, and B1 uses the real Backend with the test Harness channel. 来源解析器尚未安装、Hive 正在启动、作用域不匹配或产物缺少可验证版本时，旧的计划同步会将链接写成已撤权，并提前推进计划版本，导致用户在完结时遇到版本冲突。

## 修复

- 区分暂时无法核实、来源明确不可用、以及来源确认的版本。核实失败时，读取暂时过滤对应产物，完结和显式同步返回已有的 `missing_basis`，保留所有链接和计划版本。来源恢复后可用原版本重试。
- 来自正确作用域的权威结果仍能撤销精确的旧链接和版本。计划侧继续通过 `PlanOwner.revoke_source` 写入。
- F1 改动限于计划来源适配器、其内部符号登记和相关测试。没有数据迁移或历史撤权恢复逻辑。

## 首页 Node 门禁修复

上一轮 Node CI 的 9 条失败在发布基线和 F1 原提交上完全一致。本次将客户端修复作为独立提交追加到同一 PR。旧日志保留了原始失败证据。[原 Node CI 日志](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44983519595/job/137088975720)

- 导航测试使用真实 AppNavigation 和首页计划交接方法，补齐测试夹具中的计划通知状态。保留返回后的视口、草稿、滚动和账号隔离断言，并分别校验合法计划页签和无效页签。
- 合并后的源码本地通过 1,600 项客户端 Node 测试、12 项 F1 测试和 10 个子用例。无障碍检查新增问题为 0。[当前 CI](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44985417310) · [当前 ST](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44985417303)

2324.author: Jianyu010
2324.body:
Refs #2113, #2243. Part of the Agent Service component (dev A lane: Backend final, `main.py`, settings).

## What changes

- **Startup publication scan** (`backend/final.py`): the start step reads the Store's paged `scan_unpublished` until it ends. One blocked set lives for the whole round: the Store's `blocked_runs` plus every Run whose row did not come back RECEIVED, plus decode failures. No later row of a blocked Run is sent in that round.
- **Quarantine only on a contract violation**: `hold_rejected_publication` is called only for a deterministic Mobile contract violation, checked by a pure verifier over `egress.check_event`. UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE and decode failures never hold. A hold that raises is logged, the row counts as not held, the Run stays blocked and the round goes on.
- **Fallback**: a Store without the scan keeps today's one-page read. The choice is made once at construction.
- **Retry of parked terminals** (`backend/service.py`, `main.py`): a loop on `[recovery] terminal_reconcile_seconds` restarts the terminal path of each parked Run that is not already running. A round awaits nothing, so one hung Run does not stop later rounds. `stop` cancels the loop and everything a round started, inside its deadline.
- **Settings**: `[session_store] path` (must name a file; required when the component is enabled; relative paths resolve under the data directory).
- **Manager recovery slot** (`main.py`): an optional `recover` step between the scan and opening ingress. A failure unwinds the start; a stop during recovery keeps ingress closed.
- Docs: AS-I10, AS-I12, ledger row 21.

Behaviour with `enabled = false` is unchanged.

## For dev B (Session Store, Session Manager)

The scan is coded against a local Protocol with the names and shapes of the candidate in #2263, so the switch is a one-line change once they are in `PublicationStorePorts`:

```python
def scan_unpublished(self, *, limit: int) -> AsyncIterator[PublicationScanPage]: ...
async def hold_rejected_publication(self, *, publication: Publication) -> PublicationHoldStatus: ...
# PublicationScanPage(PublicationPage): status, publications, blocked_runs: tuple[AdmittedRunIdentity, ...] = ()
# PublicationHoldStatus(StrEnum): held, already_held, not_pending, unverified, unknown
```

Two requests, both recorded in AS-I12:
1. The candidate's hold raises `ValueError` for `durable_sequence < 1` before its own `try`. That is the one row the verifier can reject, so the hold can never return `held` for it. Please return a status instead.
2. `recover()` runs after the scan, so rows it writes wait for the next start. Say if it should run before the scan, or if the Backend should scan again after it.

## Review

Independent review found: a raising hold aborted the start; a retry round waited on every parked Run; work could run past `stop`; the Store path accepted non-file values; two untested behaviours. All fixed with failing-first tests. The review also ran the ordering logic against the candidate Store code at page sizes 1, 2 and 4.

Known limit: one terminal path has no deadline of its own while the server runs (M1, M3 and the publish have none); later rounds skip it and `stop` cancels it.

## Local gate (no CI on this base), head `e52010bec`

- `unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service`: 1025 tests OK (6 expected failures, unchanged)
- `tools/architecture/check.py` with the branch policy: no findings
- `tests/server/test_contract_package.py`, `tests/architecture/test_a02_enrollment.py`, `test_a14_contract_enrollment.py`: 91 passed

Before the component goes to `main`, the ownership row changes here (new public names of `final.py`, `final.py` → egress) need the usual main-first step.

2325.author: Jianyu010
2325.body:
Refs #759, #2113. Agent Service component, dev A lane (Harness supervisor). Test case AS-T25.

## What changes

Until now a Harness child outlived a dead server process, kept its socket, and the next server process knew nothing about it. This is new behaviour; the old code had no cleanup across restarts.

- **Launch record** (new `backend/harness_supervisor/launch_records.py`): one 0600 file per child in a private directory under the data directory. It holds pid, process group, parent, owner, kernel start time, boot identity, socket path, the SHA-256 of the launch token (never the token), the Runs, and the launching server. It is written and synced before the spawn; a failed write means nothing is spawned. It is removed only after the group is verified gone.
- **Sweep**: runs before the first launch (first `acquire`, or an explicit `sweep()`), bounded by `[supervisor] sweep_seconds`. For each record of another instance it stops the whole process group with the existing SIGTERM, grace, SIGKILL sequence, then removes the record and its socket directory. It never opens a channel to the child.
- **When it may signal**: only a group leader (`group == pid`, pid above 1, not the server's own pid or group) whose pid, start time, group and owner all match the record, re-checked immediately before each signal, and only from the same boot. Everything else is removed without a signal or left alone.
- **Live instances are never touched**: each supervisor holds an exclusive `flock` on its own lock file for its life. Another instance's files are touched only when that lock can be taken, or when a readable record proves its server gone.
- **Damaged input**: unreadable, partial, oversized, symlinked or non-regular record files (a FIFO does not block) are removed and counted; blocking file work runs off the event loop.
- Settings: four `[supervisor]` keys (`launch_record_root`, `launch_record_max_bytes`, `sweep_seconds`, `sweep_max_records`). Docs: decision AS-I15, ledger row 52.

`main.py` is unchanged. Behaviour with `enabled = false` is unchanged: nothing is constructed or created.

## Review

Independent review found one high finding (a second supervisor in the same process, or a peer server with the same pid over a shared volume, would stop a live supervisor's Harness) and four medium ones (identity checked once before two signals; a record with `group != pid` accepted; a FIFO blocking the event loop; no boot identity on Linux). All fixed; each guard was reverted on top of the fix to confirm a test catches it. The macOS `proc_bsdinfo` layout was checked against the SDK header.

## Not covered

- The Linux identity and boot queries have not been run; all tests ran on macOS.
- A server that dies between spawning a child and writing its identity leaves a record with no identity, so that child is never stopped.
- Group members whose leader exited or is a zombie are not signalled; the record is kept and reported.
- The lock rule needs `flock` to work on the data directory's file system.
- A server that never gets a Run stops its leftovers only at the first Run.

## Local gate (no CI on this base), head `756ac9a70` (includes #2324)

- `unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service`: 1056 tests OK (6 expected failures, unchanged)
- `test_as_supervisor_leftovers.py` and `test_as_st_t25_leftover_harness.py`: 20 of 20 loops each, no leftover processes
- `tools/architecture/check.py` with the branch policy: no findings
- `tests/server/test_contract_package.py`, `tests/architecture/test_a02_enrollment.py`, `test_a14_contract_enrollment.py`: 91 passed

The new file's ownership row and package entry need the main-first step before the component goes to `main`.

2327.author: Jianyu010
2327.body:
Refs #2270, #2113, #754. Agent Service component, dev A lane (HostAPI, Harness channel, Backend run coordinator). Decision AS-I16.

## What changes

- **Operation key** (`backend/host_api/endpoint.py`): a tool operation is keyed by (claim generation, Host round, model iteration, `call_id`), all counted by the Host, instead of the model's `call_id` alone. The H6 `request_id` and the call digest are stored with the plan as resend evidence. After a restart a stored plan is returned only to a resend that matches both; a call that collides with an unsettled stored plan gets `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` and nothing is dispatched.
- **`enter` outcomes**: `FENCED` refuses (Run-wide fence closes the Run; a per-attempt fence refuses only that operation). `ALREADY_ENTERED` never runs again and is reconciled by lookup. `UNKNOWN` or any unclassified exception leaves the plan `PLANNED` and answers `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`. `NOT_EXECUTED` is settled only on a lookup that proves no dispatch, or when the Host knows in the same process that it never issued the attempt.
- **H6 reply `effect`** (`harness/contract.py`, `framing.py`): new omittable field, `none` only when the Host proves the tool was never entered. It is encoded only when `none` and only for a Harness that declares `tool_effect` in `supports`; all other frames are byte-identical to before. The Beebou Harness entry declares it and tells the model "no effect" only on `none`.
- **Unknown tool outcome at Run end** (`backend/run_coordinator.py`, `final.py`, `interaction.py`): the Run is reconciled once at its end. While a plan is still unknown the Run is held without a terminal and releases its Harness slot; the periodic retry reconciles it again. After `[recovery] unsettled_effect_hold_seconds` it commits FAILED with `interrupted:tool_effect_unknown` (never `NOT_EXECUTED`; the plan row stays `PLANNED`). A user Stop on a held Run commits a stopped terminal at once. A newer claim generation ends the hold. Service shutdown does not wait for held Runs.
- **`BindingSnapshot`** is public from `server.agent_service.accounting_contracts` (same class, re-exported).
- Docs: AS-I16, AS-I10, AS-I14, ledger rows 15 and 16, the H6 row of the Harness channel contract page.

Behaviour with `enabled = false` is unchanged.

## For dev B and the Plugin Gateway owner

- Huben's acceptance on #2270 (two requests with `call_0`; request-a gets only result-1, request-b only result-2, zero new dispatch) passes, including the lost-reserve-ACK variant. The restart half is a safety net: a claim generation reaches a Harness at most once, so production does not reach it.
- A lost reserve ACK now leaves two plan rows for one logical request: the first settled `NOT_EXECUTED` by the Host (no attempt was ever issued), the retry `EXECUTED`. `test_store_tool_plans_st.py` (my test over the real Store) expects this.
- Still needed from dev B: the original session `BindingSnapshot` at Run start (B1 carries none, so `RunBindingResolver` cannot receive it); the Store first-entry permission (D6) is not wired on the Host side, only the outcome classification exists.
- A terminal from a superseded claim generation is still submitted; the real Store refuses it as STALE (read from `session_store/control.py`, not run).

## Review

Two independent reviews. The first found: a too-strict unknown guard (a variant of the acceptance case failed), Runs parked forever with their Harness slot, a never-entered plan that could not be settled, a sticky hold flag, `effect: none` without proof in two places, and the new field breaking older Harness builds. The second, on the fixes, found no must-fix item; its follow-ups (Stop during the first reconcile, shutdown wait, a permanently refused single-operation tool, six untested behaviours) are fixed here. 49 of 50 mutations fail a test; the survivor is equivalent.

## Known limits (in AS-I16)

- Parallel model loops in one Run share the iteration count; the contract cannot say which H5 an H6 belongs to, so a collision answers `ID_CONFLICT` or `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`.
- A reserve that the Store commits after answering "no plan" holds the Run until the hold limit.
- A held Run committing once its plan settles is proven through the real endpoint, not inside the full Backend with a real Store.

## Local gate (no CI on this base), head `f13d368e9` (includes #2324, #2325)

- `unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service`: 1137 tests OK (6 expected failures, unchanged)
- `temp/hive-beebou/tests` `test_beebou_*.py`: 168 OK
- `tools/architecture/check.py` with the branch policy: no findings
- `tests/server/test_contract_package.py`, `tests/architecture/test_a02_enrollment.py`, `test_a14_contract_enrollment.py`: 91 passed

The ownership row changes need the main-first step before the component goes to `main`.

2329.body:
Refs #2323、#2112、#2438；全仓 #2110；DM31-M01 #762 / M02 #763。

将连接、请求规范化、发送队列和手机持久投影集中到 Mobile Gateway，通过 AS-C2/C3 的公开代理交付业务请求和事件。Runtime 工厂消费固定快照与共享能力表；准备失败、启动失败和取消关闭按资源所有权清理，避免虚假 ready 或关闭重试提前完成。

**独立接管仍是合入条件，当前尚未通过。** 正式移动入口必须通过 Gateway 和真实业务 owner 保全原受支持功能，普通请求不得依赖 Bridge 宿主、分派或回退。当前默认 Bridge 装配及三方法 AS wire 尚未满足该条件，完整 HM-C1、真实持久 AS owner 和安装制品/HAP 联验仍待完成。详见[独立接管清单](https://github.com/lh913137941/DigitalMate/blob/codex/mobile-gateway-proxy-refactor-v1.3/docs/verification/mobile-gateway-independent-cutover-2026-11-23.md)。不请求合入或部署。

**实现内容**

- G1/G2/G3 保持连接代次、逐请求授权和原业务身份。删除旧 `mobile_gateway_adapter.py`、逐操作本地门面、混合方向代理、旧 Bridge 队列和重复 Runtime 类型；47 条函数版本映射与 6 条行为映射可核验，其中 8 条函数映射来自重构前 main、39 条来自 PR 中间版本。
- AS 持久事件按完整 `(identity, durable_sequence)` 去重。事件、手机投递义务与连续游标可靠提交后才回 `RECEIVED`；缺口先补读，读回及 socket 写出不结清 AS 发布义务。整卡答案保留原 Run/卡片/子题/answer_id，活动按执行代次和终态围栏投影。独立旧 Stop/单题答复/人的 Run 补充继续按其 owner 的授权与回执契约接通，不把转发等同于产品能力完成。
- `factory.create` 消费 Runtime #2391 的 canonical `FactoryInput`，由装配方预绑定认证和 Run 作用域。工厂校验 capability、固定快照和不可变限额；构造不打开 SQLite、不绑定 socket、不启动任务。同一设置注入 HTTP/WS、队列和 peer。
- prepare 失败/取消同时回收 runner 和投影，保留原始错误；start 失败保持 unready，Gateway 只关闭借用 listener 的副本；close 串行、可重复、超时可重试。SQLite 关闭被取消后，重试等待原关闭任务。AS unsettled 时保留事件通道与依赖。

**#2112 交接基线**

| 边界 | 固定版本与确认范围 |
| --- | --- |
| AS / Gateway | AS `1b4d13755` 的组件源码配对和限定 AS-C2/C3 语义已有 [AS 会签](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2112#issuecomment-7093993132)；[Store/Manager 会签](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2112#issuecomment-7093779041)保留真实持久 owner、历史裁剪和游标恢复缺口。旧 source_ref 及原回执保持历史含义，新复验版本单列。 |
| Runtime / Gateway | [#2438 签收](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2438#issuecomment-7095548387)固定快照、预绑定工厂、共享能力表及事件时序。当前生产方为 #2391 `67985dce5`；FactoryInput 公开类型合入/登记仍是消费方前置。 |
| Client / Gateway | HM-C1 #2409 `162af776` 已有双方设计会签；G2 操作登记、G3 账号投影、可恢复展示绑定和按实际能力开放仍需实现，不能以当前 AS profile 代替完整北向方法。A01 查询、首页停止围栏、历史、文件/报告逐项绑定对应 owner。 |

**评审跟进（`4cca548`）**：修复 F10 的当前计划索引/正文摘要；历史计划、21 条用例执行结果及阻挡状态保留。补齐 9 条现用 wire 映射和 AS-C3 持久发布结果映射，7 项聚焦检查及摘要一致性核验通过。

2330.author: Jianyu010
2330.body:
Refs #761, #754, #2113. Agent Service component, dev A lane (`main.py`, settings, Backend run coordinator, Harness supervisor). Decision AS-I17.

## What changes

Until now the Beebou Harness entry (#2309) was launched only by a test, and nothing wrote the three start keys it reads.

- **Registration from settings**: a table `[harnesses.<name>]` (`[harnesses.beebou]`, shipped `enabled = false`) is turned into a `HarnessRegistration` by `main.command_harnesses` and registered before `register_all`. The command uses the server's interpreter unless the table names one; the child's `PYTHONPATH` comes from the table. Nothing in `server/` imports `temp/`.
- **Start data** (new `backend/run_material.py`): when a Run starts on a Harness whose registration names a material, the Backend builds it once per Run, after `enter_run` and before acquiring the Harness. `BeebouRunMaterial` writes:
  - `beebou_tools` from a `BeebouToolDeclarations` source; every declared tool must be in the Run's selection, else the Run is refused;
  - `beebou_readonly_tools`: the schemas of the Host readers that are in the selection;
  - `capability_facts`: a line-for-line port of the old `beebou_capability_facts`.
- **Safety of the hook**: a material writes only the keys it declares; the keys owned by any registered material are stripped from every caller's start input; the build has a time limit (`[backend] material_seconds`); a Stop is re-checked after every wait of the start path, so a stopped Run gets no H1; a discarded Run always releases its Harness handle. Only the declared "unavailable" error is retryable; any other error refuses the Run.
- **Table against entry**: a table that does not match what the entry declares at its first hello closes the channel, refuses that core until restart without respawning, and makes `status` report not ready.
- Settings validation for the table (path elements, environment names, interpreter). Docs: AS-I17, AS-I10, AS-I14, ledger rows 15, 22, 23, 33.

With the component switch off, or the table off, behaviour is unchanged.

## What changes compared with the old code (all in the ledger)

- A profile grants a read-only tool by selecting it. The old fixed allowlist (`quick_reply.toml readonly_tools` plus the catalog's Beebou read tools) is not carried.
- Capability facts are built once per Run, not per model call.
- Only the `normal` execution has a table; the quick executions' Host side is not ported.
- The old per-message extras (personal todos, the mail-report action, routed and calendar turns) are not carried. The declarations source now receives the start context so they can be ported onto it.

## Still needed from other owners

Only Protocols with test stand-ins exist for these; no production source:
- **Beebou Harness / Bot Repository**: a real `BeebouToolDeclarations` (Bee templates, choice-card and place settings, `with_dispatch_place`).
- **Hive tools / Plugin Gateway**: a tool listing over `dm_hive_tools`, and the read-only readers themselves.
- **WorkSwarm compatibility**: a `BeeCapabilitySource`; without it the facts say "unverified", as before.
- **dev B (Session Manager / Store)**: the message `kind`, `seq` and `message_id` are not in the sealed start input, so extras keyed by them cannot be built yet.
- The production assembly must supply `run_material["beebou"]`; it waits for the Store opener.

## Review

Independent review found no must-fix for this branch and four issues to fix before the table is turned on (a leaked Harness handle on a refused retry; no time limit on the build and a Stop race; the declarations source not receiving the message; a material able to overwrite any start key), plus settings validation holes and a late mismatch check. All fixed here. A differential probe of `capability_facts` against the old function over 3000 random inputs found no mismatch. The new system test fails when the registration, any start key or the child's `PYTHONPATH` is removed.

## Local gate (no CI on this base), head `92002a323`

- `unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service`: 1186 tests OK (6 expected failures, unchanged)
- `temp/hive-beebou/tests` `test_beebou_*.py`: 168 OK
- `tools/architecture/check.py` with the branch policy: no findings
- `tests/server/test_contract_package.py`, `tests/architecture/test_a02_enrollment.py`, `test_a14_contract_enrollment.py`: 91 passed
- `test_as_st_t10_beebou_registered.py`: 10 of 10 runs, no leftover process

The new file's ownership row and package entry need the main-first step before the component goes to `main`.

2331.author: Jianyu010
2331.body:
Refs #2113, #2243. Agent Service component, dev A lane (Backend interaction, tests).

## What changes

- **Fix: no H2 answer after a Stop** (`backend/interaction.py`). `respond` checked the Stop gate before handing the send to its own task, so a Stop in between let the first H2 answer go out after the gate closed. A resend after the Stop was also sent, which could resume a Run being cancelled if the first copy had been lost. The gate is now checked in the send step itself. A first answer that was never sent returns `STALE`; a resend returns `UNKNOWN` and is not sent; an H2 that left before the gate can still be `APPLIED`, once. The question's budget pause ends only if an H2 actually went out.
- **Tests, answer in flight when Stop arrives** (`test_as_backend_questions_on_end.py`, 4 cases, both orders of the race, no real-time sleeps).
- **Tests, FAILED and CANCELLED terminal replay over the real Store** (`test_as_st_real_store_terminal_replay.py`): the terminal row is left unpublished, the Store restarts, a new Backend runs the startup resend.
  - Passing: a replayed M1 with the same `operation_id` returns the original `TerminalCommitted` and writes no new row.
  - `expectedFailure` (2): the replay to Mobile. See below.
- Ledger row 5: the answer-versus-Stop rule.

## For dev B (Session Store)

The two expected failures are in `session_store/control.py` `_commit_terminal_granted`:
1. **Row shape:** the TERMINAL publication row is written as `{"outcome": "<kind>", "candidate": ...}`. The Backend can only decode the AS-C3 `TerminalPayload` (`{"outcome": {"kind", "revision", "answer"}, "code"}`), so after a restart the row is never sent and the Run stays blocked.
2. **Revision:** `TerminalCommitted.revision` returns `request.expected_revision`. It should be the session revision after the commit, and the row should store the same value (the M1 amendment proposed on #2113).

With the row patched to AS-C3 locally, the CANCELLED case passes; the FAILED case then still loses its `code`, which needs the terminal answer and code carried in `TerminalRequest` (also part of the M1 amendment).

## Local gate (no CI on this base), head `095ba8049`

- `unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service`: 1199 tests OK (8 expected failures: the earlier 6 plus the 2 above)
- `tools/architecture/check.py` with the branch policy: no findings

Each new test was shown to fail when the behaviour it checks is removed.

2335.author: Jianyu010
2335.body:
Refs #2167, #759, #2116. Continues #2168.

## Why a second pull request

This branch is #2168 continued: all eleven commits by @itianshu are here unchanged, with their authorship, followed by one merge of `main` and my commits. I announced the takeover on #2168. Its head branch is in a private fork that I cannot read or push to (the "maintainers can edit" setting has no effect there), so the continued branch is in this repository instead. #2168 stays open. If @itianshu gives me access to the fork, I will push the same commits there and close this one; otherwise this pull request replaces #2168.

## What this does (unchanged from #2168)

The Runtime consumer of the proposed owner ports: bind the listener, prepare the selected Model/Plugin Gateways, ask Agent Service to prepare its business service, wire the owners' public request and event ports, start the selected providers, Agent Service and Mobile Gateway in order, return an on-demand readiness report, then stop admission and drain in order. The deployed CLI stays on its existing path; nothing here is activated.

## What changed since #2168 (`180b5e520`)

| Review finding on #2168 | Change |
|---|---|
| F5: no single source for the port types | New types-only module `server/server_runtime/ports.py` holds `BoundAddress`, `AgentStatus`, `ReadinessReport`, `StopReport`, the resource names `model` / `plugin` / `events` and every port Protocol. `runtime.py` imports them and defines none. Two tests guard it: `runtime.py` defines no port type, and no other module under `server/` defines a class or constant with one of these names. |
| F6: who prepares the provider set | Contract text only (RO-D1, RO-C1, RO-C6 and the collaboration checklist): a Gateway `prepare` returns its `dispatch_port`, Runtime passes it to Agent Service `prepare`, and the Registry inside Agent Service prepares and freezes the per-Profile provider set. The port signature is unchanged. This follows AS-C4/AS-C5 and the agreement on #2270. @niuypei, please object here if this does not match what you agreed. |
| F3: listener ownership after `start(listener)` | RO-C5 now says: Runtime owns the listener, lends it, and closes it on every exit path; `stop_accepting` ends every use of it; `close` needs only accepted connections; both sides are repeat-safe. A new test runs a real asyncio server on the lent listener and shows that after an unsettled stop the listener is closed, the connection accepted earlier still delivers an event, a new connection is refused, and a later repeated close is harmless. Runtime code needed no change for this. |
| F4: release aborted by cancellation | The ordered release runs as its own task. A cancellation of `serve` during the release no longer skips steps or replaces the startup error; an owner stop that ends cancelled is recorded as a failed stop; on the normal path the cancellation is raised after the last step. Three tests failed before the fix and pass now. |

A late completion cannot release borrowed resources. Both regression tests failed before the corresponding fixes. 2337.author: Jianyu010
2337.body:
Refs #2336

## What

This adds a **report-only** `proxy-rules` check to the **CI Advisory / Read-only Gate Report**. It scans the PR's exact merge tree against RFC #2110's rule: one public proxy per directed component pair, named `<Caller><Callee>Proxy`, declared in `proxy.py` (on the client, a `.ets` file of the same name).

It runs on every PR to `main`, including drafts and fork PRs, which Fast Checks skip. It never blocks a merge and never authorizes one.

| Rule | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| PX1 | Identifier or file name uses the ambiguous `MG` token |
| PX2 | `*Proxy` type names a component but is not `<Caller><Callee>Proxy` |
| PX3 | Pair proxy declared outside `proxy.py` / a same-named `.ets` file |
| PX4 | A Protocol re-declares, under another name, a Protocol of another component or a pair proxy |
| PX5 | A component imports another component's module other than its `proxy` (`server.contracts` is allowed) |
| PX6 | A Protocol names another component in full (`AgentServicePort`) but is not a pair proxy |

## How

- **Scanner:** `scripts/ci/v31_proxy_rules.py`, stdlib only.
  - Reads blobs with `git cat-file` and parses Python with `ast`; ArkTS/TS declarations are read with a regex.
  - Candidate code is never imported or executed; a test covers this.
- **Config:** `.github/ci/v31-proxy-rules.json` holds component names, paths, packages, scan roots and limits. It is read from the trusted base.
- **Gate wiring:** `scripts/ci/v31-read-only-gate.py` adds `checks["proxy-rules"]` and `proxyRules` (findings, plus the subset in changed files).
  - A missing config at base gives `not-evaluated`.
  - A scan failure gives `error` and leaves the rest of the report intact.
- **Workflow summary:** the step lists findings in changed files, with candidate text reduced to a plain character set and HTML-escaped. Every finding is in the existing `v31-advisory-json` log line.

## Verification

Python 3.13, the repo's CI venv:

- `python -m unittest discover -s tests/ci -p 'test_*.py'`: 73 tests OK. 9 are new: 8 in `test_v31_proxy_rules.py`, 1 in `test_v31_read_only_gate.py`.
- I ran the gate end to end with this branch as base against PR #2329's head. It returned `proxy-rules: advisory` with 14 findings in changed files and 29 in the tree; `authorizesMerge` stays false. I also rendered the summary block locally.
- **Scanner against current trees.** "new" means not already present on main:

  | Tree | Findings | New |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `main` | 15 | — |
  | `component/agent-service` | 19 | 4 |
  | #2328 | 26 | 11 |
  | #2329 | 29 | 14 |
  | #2281 | 20 | 5 |
  | #2272 | 15 | 0 |
  | #2168 | 19 | 4 |

  These match the manual cross-component scan posted on those PRs. One addition: `component/agent-service`'s `egress.py` declares a `PluginDispatchPort` with the same methods as `PluginGatewayProxy`.
- **Not verified:**
  - **The self-hosted runner:** the workflow change only takes effect from `main` after merge, because CI Advisory loads trusted code from the base.
  - **PRs that don't merge cleanly** (e.g. #2168 today): they keep their existing `pr-routing: error` and get no proxy-rules entry.

## Notes

- **Protected path:** this touches `.github/` (workflow and config), which the read-only report already flags as `needs-human`.
- **No change to existing behaviour:** no existing check, job, trigger or runner label changes.
- **Not in scope:** turning the check into a blocking one is a separate later decision.

**What this does**

Ports the old P16 approval gate (`harness/` `Gate`) onto HostAPI (decision AS-I18, ledger rows 26-30):

- A tool whose policy is Ask waits for the person's decision before any dispatch. The card carries the prepared-action hash; an answer with a wrong or missing hash is stale and is not recorded.
- The old mandate checks (tool, scope, budget) are carried line for line; the approval deadline comes from `[approvals] deadline_seconds`.

The gate is built only when `HostPolicy.approvals` is given; unwired, behaviour is unchanged (Ask is refused as before).

No Session Store, Session Manager or Delivery file is touched.

It found three bugs that let a Run end while a plan was still open (cancel before the wait, H8 Completed during a wait, a non-finite cost), plus seven smaller ones. 2340.body:
**What this does**

Ports the old identity, profile and binding behaviour onto the Registry and Backend (decision AS-I20, ledger rows 14, 15, 19, 42-44):

- **Assistant identity** in the Registry (`AssistantIdentity`, `IdentityRef`), with the old trim-and-default normalisation so the revision equals the old `identity_version`. The identity text reaches the Harness in H1 through the run material.
- **Profiles** (`registry/profiles.py`, `[profiles.normal]`, disabled by default) with a tool ceiling and `select_for_profile` / `select_for_existing`. Builtin skills are a profile setting, default off, as the old switch.
- **Original binding at B1.** `start_run(..., binding: BindingSnapshot | None = None)`. With `HostPolicy.registry_bindings` (default False) the Registry resolves the Run's providers once, before Store entry and before a Harness is acquired. A missing, unresolvable or mismatched binding, or an identity without a snapshot, answers `SELECTION_INVALID` and the Run is never entered. A retry with a different binding is refused.
- **Skill drift:** a skill whose content changed under the same version resolves to the current content and logs `skill_drift`; an older Session is never stranded.
- **Ceiling `ask`:** goes through the AS-I18 approval wait when the approval gate is wired; admitted otherwise.

With the switches off, behaviour is unchanged. No Session Store, Session Manager, Delivery or Plugin Gateway file is touched.

**Review**

Independent adversarial review found no way for one Run to get another Run's providers. Its findings are fixed with tests: the binding check moved to B1, tool calls refused on model/core/skill mismatch, the binding cache replaced by one resolver call, skill names `.`/`..` and outside symlinks refused. Known limits are in AS-I20 (a version 2 selection is rejected by an older decoder; readiness checks run synchronously at B1).

**For Session Manager (dev B)**: pass `binding=` from the recorded snapshot at B1, build selections with `select_for_profile` / `select_for_existing`, keep identity snapshots by revision. Details on #2210.

Refs #2336

## What

#2337 put the proxy naming scan in the CI Advisory read-only report as its own `proxy-rules` entry. That broke the layer scheme. Each entry in that table is the advisory form of one parked `1 · …` job: `pr-routing`, `feature-review`, `architecture-review`, `protected-changes`, `automation-limits`. Proxy naming, pairing and cross-component imports are module topology, which is `1 · Architecture Review`.

- **Moved into `architecture-review`:**
  - With a shared boundary touched, the entry is `needs-human`, as before, and the reason now also carries the scan result.
  - Otherwise the entry takes the scan's `advisory` or `error`, or stays `not-evaluated` when the scan is clean. Owner approvals are still not evaluated, so it never says `pass`.
  - The evidence is at `checks.architecture-review.componentProxyRules`, and the separate `proxy-rules` key is gone.
- **Renamed to `component-proxy-rule`**, so "proxy" isn't read as a network or HTTP proxy:
  - files `scripts/ci/v31_component_proxy_rules.py`, `.github/ci/v31-component-proxy-rules.json` and `tests/ci/test_v31_component_proxy_rules.py`;
  - rule IDs CPR1–CPR6;
  - summary heading **1 · Architecture Review — component-proxy-rule**.
- **No other changes:** no job, check name, trigger, runner or rule logic changes.

2342.author: Jianyu010
2342.body:
**What this does**

Ports the old Beebou quick core onto Backend as side Runs (decision AS-I21, ledger rows 22, 23, 53-62):

- `backend/side_runs.py`: when an input is queued behind a running normal Run, Backend may start a quick reply and a secondary preparation for it, each as its own Run on its own Harness (`[harnesses.beebou_quick]`, `[harnesses.beebou_second_quick]`, both disabled by default; limits in `[side_runs]`).
- **A side Run never shows a failure to the person**, as in the old code. A quick reply publishes only a completed answer; the secondary preparation never publishes. Every other ending is committed as a silent terminal with no publication obligation.
- **Quick before normal.** Before a quick answer is committed or published, Backend asks `settle_quick_reply`; a reply that comes after the normal Run claimed or committed its terminal is refused and dropped, with no context turn.
- **No person present.** An Ask tool (policy or ceiling) in a side Run is refused without an approval card, and a question opened from a side Run is refused.
- Side Runs follow the AS-I20 binding rule and the AS-I19 time limit and accounting like any Run.
- The Beebou entry computes its own tool declarations (`declarations.py`) and quick view; `max_tokens` budgets (4096 normal, 1024 quick, 4096 recovery) are owned by the Harness and sent only when the Host allows the key.

The Session Manager side is a Protocol on our side, `SideRunAdmissions`, with a stand-in. Nothing runs unless `OwnerModules.side_runs` is given and the harness tables are enabled. No Session Store, Session Manager or Delivery file is touched.

**Review**

Independent adversarial review found two gaps against the old behaviour (failed side Runs reaching the person; no ordering of the quick reply against the normal answer). Both are fixed as described above, with an ST that runs three real child processes for the in-time and late cases. Old per-message notes not yet carried are ledger rows 53-62 with owners.

**Known gaps**

- No profiles are registered yet for the two side cores, so with `registry_bindings` on a side Run has no binding and is refused. Follow-up on the Registry side (dev A).
- `[quick] max_concurrent` stays because the deployed Bridge still reads it; a test pins it equal to `[side_runs] max_concurrent` until cutover.

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

香港 test-6 的单源基准中，原 Bing 在 100 次查询中有 41 次返回非空，中位耗时 155 ms，但 80 道有标准答案的英文题里前五条命中 0 次。DuckDuckGo 经 Jina 的中位耗时为 2,055 ms，返回非空 58/100，英文 hit@5 为 26/80。Keenable 修复响应读取后为 373 ms、100/100 和 67/80。用户此前也报告过查 Dave Chappelle 却返回 Ralph Lauren 和 Lowe’s 页面，导致助手多次换工具和读页。[历史反馈 #1064](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1064)

两套完整搜索策略在搜索层另测 100 次查询，基线版非空 60/100、英文 hit@5 为 12/80，candidate 的带 Key 竞速组合分别为 100/100 和 69/80。下面的 Agent 评测以实际交付的答案、引用和耗时计分。

**candidate 的改动**

1. **调整选源。** 默认并发请求 Keenable 和 DuckDuckGo 经 Jina，先取得可用结果的一方供 Bee 使用。两者都无可用结果再走 Bing。可通过 `DIGITALMATE_FREE_SEARCH_KEENABLE=false` 恢复原有选源策略。
2. **修复 Keenable 的读取与认证。** 完整读取受大小上限保护的分块 JSON，向搜索子进程传递配置的 Key。日志记录认证结果、获胜源及缓存状态，可区分成功调用和最终采用。
3. **按问题决定是否读页。** 简单稳定事实的摘要须明确支持所问实体与关系，才可直接回答并引用原链接。用户要求打开原文、信息易变或证据冲突时，读取一到两个相关页面；核实失败时明确说明。
4. **限制 research 开销。** `DIGITALMATE_RESEARCH_SEARCH_CAP` 默认 5，可配置为 1–20，控制 research 的搜索预算。此次分组没有单独测量该项的因果收益。

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #1064 — 搜索接口偶发返回与问题实体无关的结果，触发多次工具回退和页面抓取。此 PR 改进选源与取证，issue 保留用于跟踪复杂查询与尾延迟。

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

普通附来源问法，两版都是 15/15 答对且引用有依据。candidate 有 10 次直接引用足以作答的摘要，5 次以正文为据；Bee 模型调用从 72 次降到 38 次，p50 从 23.23 秒降到 15.79 秒，p95 从 99.44 秒降到 41.07 秒。

明确要求核实正文的 15 次任务，基线版 15/15 交付，candidate 14/15 交付，交付的答案均有正文证据。《史记》主要作者核实题在 36.82 秒后入口返回 failed，未派出 Bee，也没有搜索请求。整体 candidate 的 p50 从 28.76 秒降到 17.95 秒，p95 从 116.16 秒变为 120.72 秒。这批题支持“普通附来源问题更快”，没有显示最终正确率或整体尾延迟提升。

candidate 共记录指定 Key 的 42 次认证尝试、39 次 HTTP 200、39 次实际采用 Keenable 非缓存结果，覆盖 29/30 个任务。未交付的核实任务仍计入分母。

**全部任务**

| 指标 | v0.1.13 基线版 | candidate（摘要版） |
|---|---:|---:|
| 端到端任务 | 30 | 30 |
| 核心答案正确 | 30/30 | 29/30 |
| 引用有轨迹证据 | 30/30 | 29/30 |

| p50（秒） | 28.76 | 17.95 |

| p99（秒） | 157.31 | 146.46 |

|---|---:|---:|

<details>
<summary>评测口径与 15 道题的逐项对照（两种问法，每版 30 次）</summary>

15 道稳定事实题（8 道中文、7 道英文），每题分别用普通附来源和明确要求打开正文两种问法，每版 30 次。同一模型 deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017、同一模型凭据、同一节点及资源规格，每题新会话。所有 Agent 任务串行，从 DigitalMate WebSocket 发送用户消息计时到终态，包含失败，服务启动到 ready 的时间单列在计时窗口之外。基线版在较晚时段运行，网络和模型服务的时段差异会影响对照。

基线为接入 Keenable 前的 v0.1.13 发布提交 `e319c05a0`（镜像摘要前缀 `756e57035e08`）。candidate 的 Agent 数据来自 release 测试镜像 `c60a45f8` 加认证与摘要策略补丁。最终 PR 提交的分支级验证另列。此实验比较两套组合策略，不能分摊各项改动的独立贡献。

核心答案与引用分开核对。被引 URL 在轨迹中有支持结论的摘要或已读页面才计引用分；明确核实题另查引用正文。Bee 模型调用来自 Bee 的 usage，路由模型调用按成功逻辑 ID 去重。p95、p99 取 nearest-rank，每组 15 次时 p95 为最慢任务，每版 30 次时 p99 为最慢任务。

2349.author: Jianyu010
2349.body:
Refs #2113 and #2263. Implements AS-I22 in the Agent Service implementation decisions.

The Agent Service accepts an owner-modules opener for Session Store, Session Manager and Delivery, and prepares enabled side profiles through the Registry. The owner keeps its own persistence and lifecycle interfaces. The deployed Bridge remains on its existing path.

Startup now runs publication scan, Manager recovery, and a second publication scan before opening ingress. The regression writes a new durable event during recovery, checks that Mobile sees the original sequence while ingress is closed, and checks the publication obligation is cleared. This covers the ordering reported in #2113 (comment 7080480572). Shutdown drains requests handed to Delivery and closes the owner modules only after a complete stop. Prepare rollback is bounded by the configured stop grace.

## Verification

Base `ef2a2e54a`, head `82537cbc1`.

- Agent Service discovery ran twice, 1,532 tests each, both OK with seven existing expected failures.
- Beebou Harness discovery passed 188 tests.
- Architecture checked 414 of 656 files with zero blocking findings and three existing Bridge size warnings.
- Contract package, A02 and A14 enrollment passed 91 tests and 1,399 subtests.

The restart test uses SQLite-backed Store and a real Harness process with a controlled owner opener and gateway stand-ins. Production owner assembly, deployment and device acceptance remain open.

2350.body:
Refs #2113, #2167 and #2335.

Bring the merged Runtime source into the Agent Service integration branch and consume its published lifecycle types. Agent Service callers import the five lifecycle types directly from Runtime. The source guard checks duplicate definitions and indirect public exports. No new component is activated.

The combined source exposed a packaging mismatch. The root wheel already had an exact Runtime plus Agent Service layout, while the A01 build-context test and Docker allowlist still covered the smaller main tree. Check the combined source against the exact reviewed wheel layout, keep the pinned A01 baseline, require one explicit context rule per member, and continue to reject unreviewed files.

On `a206f06d` with component base `3ce499775`, the focused Runtime, source-ownership, build-context and Agent Service entry suite passed 140 tests and 307 subtests. The exact head passed two Agent Service runs (1,573 tests, seven existing expected failures per run), 189 Beebou tests, architecture (417 of 659 files with three existing Bridge size warnings) and 92 package/enrollment tests with 1,399 subtests. The tests build the root wheel and compare its files, and use real local listeners with controlled gateway participants. The deployed entry, real owner wiring and device acceptance retain the scope recorded in ADR-0037.

2351.author: Jianyu010
2351.body:
Refs #2113, #2300 and #2333. Implements AS-I25 for the Agent Service Backend and Harness supervisor.

- Record Stop as confirmed only following authoritative Harness observation or verified supervisor teardown. Keep the bounded grace window and report uncertainty when teardown is unconfirmed.
- Preserve the original H2 answer for replay. Refuse a changed answer under the same submission key and share one in-flight channel attempt across concurrent callers.
- Bound launch-record sweeps, keep old instance locks until outstanding native operations return, and retry work deferred by a page or deadline. Use unverified capability metadata when optional discovery is unavailable.
- Add migration ledger rows 63–66 and distinguish attached-Run plan recovery from cold-start reconciliation. The latter still depends on its owning Store and Plugin Gateway ports.

Head `a4ddedc24` includes the opener integration at `07e30ee25`. Full Agent Service discovery ran twice, 1,572 tests each, with seven existing expected failures. Beebou passed 189 tests and architecture checked 414 of 656 files without blocking findings. Contract package and A02/A14 enrollment passed 91 tests and 1,399 subtests. Earlier runs caught an unnecessary lock-release timeout, a private ownership violation and a 10 ms test fixture race. The final branch preserves the original assertions. Deployment and device acceptance remain unrun.

2351.title: fix(agent-service): preserve Stop, answer replay and recovery evidence

The real local API smoke covered both note-toggle branches and concurrent credential isolation. Related search tests passed 80 tests and 28 subtests, with one WorkSwarm test blocked by a missing local dependency. No network search or deployment was run.

Native CI run 45040837007 stops at Verify trusted snapshot transport on `8c4feb381`. The Architecture job never exports `14b53f36`, so the candidate verdict is unrun. 2353.author: Jianyu010
2353.body:
Refs #2113, #2167 and #2300. Implements the selected AS-I24 / AS-I30 component batch on #2350.

- Bound model admission and dispatch with the same deadline. Stop fences queued registration and suppresses late H5 output. Record expected and unexpected attempt outcomes using the original physical attempt.
- Carry negotiated H5 failure causes into Beebou H8 and Backend/Mobile failure publication. The subprocess regression drives a controlled HTTP 429 and verifies one classified terminal for a capable Harness and the existing fallback for an older Harness.
- Normalize images with bounded decoding and recheck owner-issued attachment holds before handoff. Production Store/Attachment integration remains open.
- Validate the physical attempt and call identity before settling a tool plan from a lookup receipt. Preserve channel response correlation across timeout, cancellation and same-ID retry, and deliver terminal H9 before EOF. Cold-start orphan plan settlement remains with the pending owning ports.
- Include both new Python modules in the explicit Docker build context and the reviewed root-wheel layout.

Candidate `bad8825b`, component base `18a54686`. Python 3.13.13 with Pillow 13.0.0 and aiohttp 3.14.5. The exact component gate ran 1,649 Agent Service tests twice with seven existing expected failures on each run, 190 Beebou tests, architecture (419 of 661 files with three existing Bridge size warnings) and 92 package/enrollment checks with 1,399 subtests. The prior run reproduced a detach event-loop spin and then exposed out-of-date descriptor and approval fixtures. The final head filters completed evidence futures and verifies full H0 capabilities and valid original-attempt settlement. The tests use the actual Agent Service, Host, local SQLite accounting, Unix sockets, the Beebou subprocess and built root wheel, with controlled Gateway, Store and Manager participants where production ports are unavailable. Production deployment and device acceptance remain unrun.

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Adds an explicit, default-off owner bootstrap candidate for Phase 2B. It opens a SQLite Store, requires an injected builder, and wraps binding, recovery, readiness, and shutdown. It is not registered with the production entry and does not implement the missing Manager, Delivery, authorization, or recovery owners.

The selected delivery-profile SQLite schema is experimental: opening an empty Store initializes its schema, while an existing non-Delivery profile is rejected; it does not establish interoperability with other profiles. Compatibility with checkpoint and other profiles, safe rollback, and production rollout are not established. Do not enable this against production data. The builder is trusted; these checks do not prove all supplied owner ports use the same database. The ownership inventory change is included for review only; the applicable producer/inventory-first rule must be resolved before merge.

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
Draft candidate for a shared per-Run SQLite publication sequence, motivated by #2113 discussion: question, Steer consumption and terminal events need one ordered sequence. The private helper appends within a caller-owned transaction, preserves original event identity on replay, rejects different content and detects damaged or noncontiguous retained rows. It does not create a database or commit a transaction.

This is **not wired into any Store schema or event writer**. The test creates a temporary candidate table; existing production profiles, package inventory and actual callers do not use this module. Caller must verify the original Run claim, current authorization and Stop/terminal fence under the same write transaction. Shared sequence migration from existing Steer and terminal rows, atomic question/answer and rejection closure, original event identity mapping, scan/hold/mark, backwards compatibility, rollback and concurrent old-writer fencing are all unimplemented. The DDL and proposed ownership are review candidates only. The module is not enrolled in the architecture inventory or contract package; a separate reviewed inventory change must precede implementation merge. Do not enable against real data.
