2379.author: huben0423-hw
2379.body:
/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Draft candidate for durable first-run claim, first entry and Stop fencing on the same SQLite admission owner. A newly admitted Run and its authority enrollment are inserted in one transaction. First claim and its immutable selection can be read back after reopen; one original entry attempt is persisted so another opener or new process returns UNKNOWN rather than granting a second H1. Stop stores a receipt and fences entry atomically; Stop receipt means the request/fence was stored, not that execution has stopped. Corrupt claim or Stop evidence fails closed. Existing pre-upgrade Runs are not silently classified under the new authority.

This PR is stacked on #2262 head `249b18ac1` while still targeting `component/agent-service`; its current diff includes that unmerged checkpoint work. The **incremental** authority commit is `d9711271d`, and #2378 supplies its trusted schema dependency. It is deliberately draft: the candidate uses experimental schema v6; version allocation is not final; it implements first-start only (no supersede/resume or terminal owner); real authorization and immutable selection sources are controlled test inputs; Manager/Host/Delivery are not wired to it. Checkpoint capability on this profile requires an explicitly supplied same-Store durable authority; without it, opening fails closed. The candidate checks the original entry and Stop fence in the same SQLite transaction as checkpoint access. Do not activate or merge as a complete authority implementation.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Refs #2202, #2203, #2197, #2113, #2262

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results (Function, performance, reliability, etc.)**:

Exact candidate `2f2024ae6ca84c6de12ab2bb9689f2f44aa83d50`, tree `90bdc730e238a9b1774c09c1dd379a78a5aac2d7`; integration base `47393a50311c3a2874fe54b94dae0272437b1e96`; stacked checkpoint baseline `249b18ac1d9517b8e3ae89a63a697fc0d0fda49c`.

- WSL Python 3.12: 237 focused Store, Manager bootstrap, checkpoint, Delivery, accounting, schema and A01 tests passed. Tests use real local SQLite and controlled authorization/selection; two subprocess tests reopen the file and demonstrate original claim readback, no duplicate entry and retained Stop fence. No real Harness is dispatched in those subprocesses.
- Incremental authority production lines versus `249b18ac1`: 296/316 executable changed lines covered (93.67%) with coverage.py 7.2.7. This is not whole-PR line or branch coverage.
- Contract-package suite: 79 passed on the exact candidate tree. #2378 trusted policy scan of the exact source tree: 428/670 files checked, no findings, with three existing Bridge size warnings.
- Not run/proven: full component ST, real Host/Manager wiring, production auth, production checkpoint/authority assembly, terminal/supersede/recovery, device/deployment or hosted CI. No existing legacy workspace is migrated.

**Self-checklist**:
+ - [ ] **Design**: Root #2183/#2187 inform this prototype; the final schema, full authority and wiring decisions remain open.
+ - [ ] **Test**: Focused tests are included; actual end-to-end owners and full ST remain outstanding.
+ - [x] **Verification**: Exact tree, participants, coverage and unverified cases are recorded above.
+ - [ ] **Interface**: Candidate interfaces and callbacks are not approved for production use.
+ - [ ] **Document**: No official website documentation change.


**Stack sync:** Head `6b18aa43fcbaa9a02e9c13157c7f0097915ad557` merges the current #2262 head `f96b2e3380a6e4c5de9d3c69816c352da08d984f`, including its recovery lookup disclosure fix. Exact tree `5dde492c53fa2cf39a640a26cf8710b5e06f8911` passed 237 WSL focused tests; incremental authority changed-line coverage against `f96b2e338` is 296/316 (93.67%). Exact-tree package and trusted-policy scans are running. The prototype limitations and controlled-auth scope above remain unchanged.


**Shared durable checkpoint fence:** Head `2c769af879394ae5cc22ecb37c2c65b8cc0e26d9` merges integration `3aaaf55f` (#2380). Exact tree `542f592c6d31e262a3d50e65eeac27ef36620575` passed 241 WSL Python 3.12 focused tests, 79 contract-package tests and the #2380 candidate trusted-policy scan (428/670 files, no findings, three existing Bridge size warnings). Incremental changed production-line coverage against checkpoint baseline `f96b2e338` was 363/390 (93.08%) under coverage.py 7.2.7. A real SQLite/subprocess test loses the checkpoint commit ACK, persists Stop, creates a fresh process and reads the original operation receipt without supplying the checkpoint key; another test holds Host verification while Stop commits and verifies no later checkpoint is written. A foreign Store authority is refused. Host attestation and selection remain controlled; no real Harness, production authorization, terminal/supersede owner or deployed assembly was exercised. F8 cancelled-run settlement remains unimplemented.


**Combined integration candidate:** head `f66084b9d4afc6bb146f637bf904df4fc81b4198` incorporates component `f481ee43ce39eac9557003498b6c97dd6828aff4`. This remains a draft stack, including unmerged checkpoint work from #2262 and the in-memory Stop/terminal candidate from #2300; it is not an independently mergeable complete authority implementation. It adds same-file first-claim and entry fencing, experimental Stop observation persistence, same-owner accounting/checkpoint capability and a default-off SQLite M5–M7 candidate. The local schema profiles and watermarks are experimental, not an allocated shared production schema. Trusted selection, authorization and the Stop-observation verifier are controlled inputs; no real observer is supplied by this PR.

Windows Python 3.12 on this head: authority enrollment, Store tool plans, checkpoint system and adapter, Manager Stop/terminal, Store control/terminal and contract signatures: **195 passed, 106 subtests passed**. These include real SQLite and targeted reopen/lost-ack tests; the real Host integration still uses a controlled Plugin Gateway. Linux/native CI, full architecture, deployed integration and full component acceptance were not run for this head. Durable question/approval, full publication and actual context/terminal transaction, upgrade of legacy workspace data, production owner assembly and full Manager/Delivery wiring are not complete. Never use the current in-memory terminal revision as proof of the actual context head. The draft must not close the linked issues on this evidence.


**Experimental journal bootstrap:** head `22ca4da01048c51e6401ed13eefe98c6bf8f33a1` adds explicit journal-profile schema and creates an empty per-Run watermark in the same transaction as a new durable admission. Upgrading an already admitted Run does not infer an empty history. The profile version is experimental and not an allocated shared watermark. This does not yet implement terminal/question fact writes into the journal, publication replay, or a production opener; the draft remains blocked on those items and the previously documented owner/transaction boundaries.

Windows Python 3.12 on this head: authority enrollment, tool plans, checkpoint schema and contract signatures: **100 passed, 89 subtests passed**, including failed watermark insert rollback, new admission and reopen. Full joint tests, hosted CI and production data migration were not run.


**Experimental journal append:** head `873c8336983e850ef71c087ae77027445cd6c833` adds a transaction-scoped SQLite publication append/replay primitive. It requires the caller's authorized write transaction and an admission-created Run head, verifies retained sequence and payload identities, preserves the first operation/content on replay, and never creates missing history for an upgraded Run. Windows Python 3.12 authority enrollment, publication and contract signature tests: **117 passed, 95 subtests passed**; tests cover rollback and conflicting replay. No terminal/question fact writer, publication read/mark owner or production opener is wired to this primitive yet; the schema/profile and shared transaction remain experimental. This is not a real Gateway joint test, production authority, or evidence to close #2208.


**Experimental SQLite journal read/mark:** head `f3d74ec33b859618d77d67afd0f3631135795ea4` validates per-Run sequence, identity digest, publication kind and canonical JSON before reading or marking within the caller's authorized transaction. A missing or damaged head is not an empty page. Windows Python 3.12 authority enrollment, Store publication and signature tests: **117 passed, 95 subtests passed**. This is a transaction primitive only: no Gateway-facing authorized scan/hold/mark owner, durable terminal fact writer, production opener or Gateway joint run is supplied. The profile remains experimental and this PR remains draft.


**Experimental authorized publication reads:** head `a95ddee45813a647cf56597da4b8c1c0a3de98fa` adds a same-Store SQLite `read_publications` / `mark_published` slice using a trusted complete publication catalog, exact admitted submission/Run matching, and current-access rechecks inside the transaction. Unavailable/corrupt history and revoked authority return UNKNOWN; a lost mark-commit acknowledgement reconciles the original mark. The test appends a controlled synthetic journal event, not an actual terminal. Windows Python 3.12 authority enrollment, Store publication and signature tests: **117 passed, 95 subtests passed**. This is not yet the complete `PublicationStorePorts`: scan, quarantine/hold/release, durable actual terminal/question writers, production access, real opener and joint Gateway verification remain missing. The schema and owner remain experimental; keep the PR draft.


**Experimental SQLite publication scan:** head `02cfff89884943b48c8a4c93dcc937e5b4090407` adds paged pending-event scan and first-page reads over a fixed authorized catalog, with per-page current-authority and original Run checks. Missing/corrupt Run history is isolated as blocked; authority changes return UNKNOWN. Windows Python 3.12 authority enrollment, Store publications and contract signatures: **118 passed, 95 subtests passed**, including pagination, revocation and corruption. Events are controlled synthetic journal rows; the durable terminal producer, quarantine/hold/release, complete production opener and real Gateway joint test remain missing. The profile is experimental and the PR remains draft.


**Integration sync and architecture:** head `77f2d6e029ec2bb8eae340cbef7e03c0470ab1dc` merges locally fetched component `3db5821d737b15b70e4b95ae838fd3594d40d325` and retains both sides of the Manager-Backend side-run contract. Windows Python 3.12 authority enrollment, Store publication, contract signatures and side-run tests: **130 passed, 95 subtests passed**. Ownership manifest validation: 170 owners, zero exceptions. The merged head passed the architecture source scan from a clean checkout with zero findings. Synthetic publication rows and controlled authority remain; terminal producer, durable Inbox/admission integration, production opener and real Gateway joint verification are not supplied. This is still a draft; no completion or CI claim is made.


**Admission corruption handling:** head `e18d8db47f1d29a39c503c76bc87152f6d56e4ce` validates the stored submission payload against its canonical encoding and fingerprint before replay or conflict classification; corrupted prior evidence returns UNKNOWN. Windows Python 3.12 Manager admission system, Delivery execution SQLite, authority enrollment and contract signatures: **106 passed, 66 subtests passed**. Controlled providers and existing draft limitations remain; this is not real end-to-end P0 validation.


**Integration update:** head `7a1a763b14d1db9fae2d75c435d8ea44f8e47b75` merges component `fb3cc49860eaea39d7e169f44399bac56189ee68` including #2422, #2431 and #2436. Windows Python 3.12 Manager admission system, Delivery execution SQLite, authority enrollment and contract signatures: **106 passed, 66 subtests passed**. Production assembly, shared SQLite migration with approval, terminal writer and Gateway joint testing are still absent; controlled providers remain. A clean checkout architecture scan of this head returned zero findings; hosted CI has not been run.


**A02 correction:** head `043e287e4` incorporates #2444, superseding the earlier Admission corruption handling paragraph. The reviewed A02 contract permits reconciliation from the retained fingerprint/association when content bytes are corrupt; reading the content itself still fails with unknown knowledge. Windows Python 3.12 A02 and Manager admission system: **54 passed, 56 subtests passed**. Real Gateway, production assembly and full component ST remain NOT_RUN.

2386.author: haowenz001
2386.body:
## Problem

A `workflow_dispatch` always carries its input defaults, so `inputs.e2e_target` was never empty. The job resolves `TARGET: ${{ inputs.e2e_target || vars.E2E_DEVICE_TARGET || '127.0.0.1:5555' }}`, so the non-empty default `127.0.0.1:5555` shadowed the repository variable and every dispatched Nightly booted the local emulator.

Scheduled runs have no `inputs` context and do use `E2E_DEVICE_TARGET`, but GitHub only fires `schedule` on the default branch. Release branches (e.g. `release_v0.1.13`) run Nightly only through dispatch, so their E2E always ran on the emulator even with a real device attached to the runner.

Evidence from run 45041410811 (`release_v0.1.13`): the E2E log shows `TARGET: 127.0.0.1:5555` and `模拟器已连接`, while the same job's `hdc list targets` lists both `127.0.0.1:5555` and `7DZ9K26909000238`. The 11-19 run 44542821155 had `TARGET: 7DZ9K26909000238`, so the real-device path itself works when the input is passed explicitly.

The block came in with the dispatch inputs (#2251 on main; `release_v0.1.13` carries the same code). The input description and the workflow comment both say an untouched dispatch behaves like a scheduled run, but the default contradicted that.

## Change

- `e2e_target` default: `127.0.0.1:5555` -> empty. Resolution stays input -> repository variable `E2E_DEVICE_TARGET` -> `127.0.0.1:5555`. Pass `127.0.0.1:5555` (or a serial) explicitly to override for one run.
- `docs/guides/testing/ci.md`, the nightly-execution case reference and `docs/UPDATES.md` updated to match.

## Verification

- `nightly.yml` parses; the dispatch input default is now `""`.
- Not yet exercised by a real dispatch from this branch; the release-branch real-device run being verified in parallel passes `e2e_target` explicitly, so it does not depend on this change.
2386.head: fix/nightly-e2e-realdevice-default
2386.title: fix(ci): let an untouched Nightly dispatch use E2E_DEVICE_TARGET

2387.author: Jianyu010
2387.body:
Refs #2113.

## Why

#2374 added five methods to `PublicationStorePorts` (`scan_unpublished`, `hold_rejected_publication`, `read_held_publication`, `scan_held_publications`, `release_held_publication`). Seven Agent Service tests failed on the component head since then (`test_as_contract_signatures` ×6, `test_as_st_real_store_idempotency` ×1).

## What changed

- **Contract page, stand-in, shape test:** the host/Store ports page, `StandInSessionStore` and the shape test carry the five methods and their value types.
- **Backend uses the Store's port directly:** `backend/final.py` drops its local `PublicationScanPorts`, `PublicationScanPage` and `PublicationHoldStatus`, and the one-page `read_unpublished` fallback with `StartupScanReport.paged`. Paged scan to the end, one blocked set per round and hold only for an AS-C3 violation are unchanged.
- **Bad ports refused at assembly:** `final.check_publication_ports` raises `TypeError("missing dependency: OwnerModules.publications.<method>")` before any module starts, for each of the four methods Backend calls.
- **`OpenQuestionPorts`:** the text now says `REJECTED` and `NONE_OPEN` are both successful closure, with a replay test over all four answer pairs.
- **Tests:** the scripted Harness helper loads without `resource`; two timing-dependent channel tests now wait on state (20/20 under 40 CPU burners, previously 3 failures in 20).
- **Docs:** AS-I12 item 11 records the semantic differences from the old local Protocol; AS-I9 and the launcher docstring state that the Harness supervisor supports POSIX hosts only; ledger row 21 is consistent.

## Behaviour to know

On a real Store the hold cannot hold anything today: the only violation `check_event` can find in a decoded row is `durable_sequence < 1`, and the port answers `UNVERIFIED` for that before asking the verifier. `NoHoldWithRealComponentsTest` pins this with the real `MobileEgress` and verifier, and fails the day `check_event` gains a content rule.

## Independent review

A reviewer who did not write the code ran a 63-step differential probe of the stand-in against the real `SessionStorePublicationPorts` and 14 mutants of `final.py` (all killed). No must-fix. Should-fix items applied here: refusal at assembly, four stand-in divergences aligned and pinned by `test_as_store_publication_parity.py` (12 answers differed before), real-component hold test, ledger consistency.

No file under `session_store/` or `backend/session_manager/` is edited. `tests/server/agent_service/test_owner_bootstrap.py` gains a small `PublicationsWithoutScan` wrapper because the shared stand-in now has the scan; its assertion is unchanged.

## Gates on e596a1baa (contains 53f786eaf)

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Agent Service suite, run twice | 1755 tests, OK, 7 expected failures, both runs |
| Beebou | 190 tests, OK |
| Architecture | `checked 423 of 665 files`, no findings |
| Contract and enrollment | 91 passed, 1 failed, 1399 subtests |

The one failure is `tests/architecture/test_a02_enrollment.py::StoreEnrollmentTests::test_exact_checked_files_and_real_public_owner_are_clean`. It fails the same way on the plain head 53f786eaf: its hard-coded Session Store file set lacks six files that are in the ownership policy (`publications.py`, `publication_log.py`, `checkpoints.py`, `checkpoint_codec.py`, `checkpoint_recovery_ports.py`, `delivery_permits.py`). This branch does not touch that test or those files; reported to the Store owner on #2113.

2391.author: Evelynn-V
2391.body:
Refs #2438, #2116, #2167, #759.

## Runtime 侧契约

[Runtime 侧签收记录](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2438#issuecomment-7095548387)确认了固定快照、预绑定工厂、能力依赖表和事件交接。组件提供方的接口签收和生产启用仍按 ADR-0037 执行。

- Boot 是同步阻塞的进程入口。它只读一次配置，向各工厂交付 `FactoryInput`，包含本组件只读配置段和同一快照 ID。配置不触发动态工厂导入。
- Agent Service 和 Mobile Gateway 的工厂收到同一份只读 `required_by_capability`。Provider Gateway 工厂只接收自己需要的配置和 ID。显式禁用必需 Agent 或缺少必需 Gateway 时，Boot 在构造、绑定前失败。
- Agent `start()` 重放事件时，Mobile 已经完成 `prepare()`，外部监听稍后才开放。当前 Model `dispatch_port` 和生命周期签名继续沿用，流式能力和输出预算的公开类型由 Model 与 Agent 双方另行确认。

[Boot 设计](https://github.com/Evelynn-V/DigitalMate/blob/c1c3499e65833d5388343e766c1dd404181d88e4/docs/implementations/contracts/server-runtime-boot-v1.md) · [组件签收模板](https://github.com/Evelynn-V/DigitalMate/blob/c1c3499e65833d5388343e766c1dd404181d88e4/docs/implementations/contracts/server-runtime-component-startup-template.md)

## 验证

- PASS：`python -B -m unittest discover -s tests/server -p 'test_server_runtime*.py'`，33 项。独立子进程使用真实回环 HTTP、停机信号和四个组件替身，覆盖单次读配置、快照 ID、只读共享能力表及启动事件重放。新增 BOOT-T1 配置文件替换反例和 BOOT-T4 旧能力表冲突反例。后者只覆盖受控 Agent 拒绝后 Runtime 不再推进，真实 Agent 与安装制品验收待执行。
- 历史架构扫描在旧基线报告 FactoryInput 及 ASModelProxy 登记问题。#2455 已合入 main；本次未重跑可信架构门禁。
- NOT RUN：真实组件工厂、正式制品和生产启用验收。部署入口未切换。

Head: `c1c3499e65833d5388343e766c1dd404181d88e4`.

## RFC 检视处理

已将 #2438 与 [版本化规范](https://github.com/Evelynn-V/DigitalMate/blob/c1c3499e65833d5388343e766c1dd404181d88e4/docs/implementations/contracts/server-runtime-boot-v1.md) 统一为 BOOT-C1～C8 / BOOT-T1～T6，并补齐入口签名、快照语义、预绑定工厂边界和 Agent 监听归属。真实组件仍需签收快照核对和能力表消费。

## 第 3 次检视回填

复验 PR head `0668ddd2617bef076fe9471567b63588a9b6d084`，Runtime/Boot 30 项通过，`git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` 通过。检视针对较早的代码，以下列明各条修复和现有验证边界。

| 意见 | 处理与证据 |
| --- | --- |
| [F4 停机逾期清理](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2391#discussion_r4663484726) | `84106d3ee` 增加有界 `cleanup_grace`。反例覆盖逾期 owner 在宽限内继续清理、结果仍为 unsettled、传输保持未关闭。生产硬退出策略待部署 owner 签收。 |
| [F5 契约编号](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2391#discussion_r4663484737) | #2438 正文和 Boot v1 使用同一组 BOOT-C1～C8、BOOT-T1～T6。 `be58d58df` 补上用例标识、文件替换和旧能力表冲突反例。真实 owner 验收仍单独记录。 |
| [F3 文档索引](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2391#discussion_r4663484750) | `be58d58df` 补契约索引，`84106d3ee` 补契约及仓库两级更新日志。 |
| [F6 TOML 诊断](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2391#discussion_r4663484757) | `84106d3ee` 区分 UTF-8 和 TOML 语法错误，保留安全的行列信息。反例校验错误类别及提示不打印配置键。 |

## Plugin Gateway 反馈

按 [#2438 Plugin owner 回复](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2438#issuecomment-7095894519) 补充 BOOT-C6/T3。Agent 在准备阶段可用公开端口绑定 Registry 结果和读取声明，实际派发与观察查询在 Plugin 启动后开放；Agent 收束前保留查询。新增替身进程测试覆盖上述交接和禁用 Plugin。真实 `create(FactoryInput)`、快照核对、借用 Executor 生命周期和 Agent 对冻结绑定的接入仍在 #2357 / #2412 跟进。

## 四组件反馈汇总与 Model 接线

按 [#2438 Model Gateway 回复](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2438#issuecomment-7096209925) 更新 BOOT-C5/C7 和四组件交接表。Boot 选中 Model 时，Runtime 从同一个准备句柄取得派发口和精确绑定的只读设置。Agent 通过候选 `model_binding_settings` 参数在 prepare 阶段校验。缺失映射在 Runtime 层提前失败，缺少所需绑定或同名但不同快照由 Agent 校验。直接调用 serve 的已有派发型调用方保留原调用行为。

当前 head 的 31 项本地用例通过。真实 Model 与 Agent 对新参数的联合签收、真实组件联验和部署切换仍待完成。

## 同步 main 与 #2438 新反馈

合入 main `dd24a9f8`，三处契约目录与更新日志冲突均保留两边条目。按 [Agent Phase 4 回复](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2438#issuecomment-7097151951) 将工厂构造移入同一个生命周期事件循环，保留配置单次读取、启动前校验和原启停顺序。按 [Plugin 更新签收](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2438#issuecomment-7098254260) 更新 #2357/#2433 和安装轮测试的证据边界。#2476 的真实 Model 设置交接、AS-I22 的真实工厂、正式部署仍待联调。

本地复验：Runtime/Boot 31 项、主干 Model 配置 9 项、Model 生命周期 19 项，合计 59 项通过。Git 差异检查通过。

## 启动期间的停机通知

Boot 在组件准备前开始等停机通知。若通知先到，Runtime 取消进行中的启动阶段，停止启动后续组件，并按现有顺序回收已经取得的句柄。直接使用低层 serve 的调用方可按需开启相同行为。新增 BOOT-T1 反例：Agent 恢复中收到停机通知，即使 Agent 在本地处理取消，Mobile 也不会开放接入，已准备句柄完成回收。当前 head 的 32 项 Runtime/Boot 测试通过。长时间不响应取消的 owner 仍需部署层的进程退出策略。

## Jianyu010 检视修复

[启动停机竞态](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2391#discussion_r4665065477) 已复现并修正。Agent.start 置位停机事件后立即返回时，生命周期阶段交接先让已经唤醒的通知等待任务运行，再决定是否调用下一个 owner。回归在旧实现触发 Mobile.start 断言，修复后确认 Mobile 不开放接入且已准备句柄有序回收。当前 head 运行 33 项 Runtime/Boot 用例通过。

Refs #2113, #1268 and #2389.

The disabled WorkSwarm command Harness routes the legacy rail through Host H6 for approvals, planning and dispatch. The rail carries the prepared WorkSwarm request ID, so a retained native Session can serve a later Run while refusing a delayed request from the earlier Run. H2 queues early inputs until native send acknowledgement, then claims and records witnessed steering through H2b. The child uses legacy normal mode and can activate the six reviewed defaults. Reads of a selected skill's `SKILL.md` go through the bound Host `skill_tool` route.

The independent review reproduced cross-Run rail admission, premature consumption of a steer, and duplicate legacy tool declarations. Red-first probes cover the fixes. On the final head, the real legacy rail and model serializer produced one Host schema per selected canonical tool in both input orders. Exact proof rejected a delayed request on a fresh socket. Stop and channel loss before native acknowledgement prevented a consumption claim. Approval execution uses a separate bounded wait, while the Host retains settlement of the original operation.

| Gate | Result at `50274337e` with component `527d93f15` |
| --- | --- |
| Agent Service unittest discovery | 1,823 tests each run, OK twice with seven existing expected failures |
| Beebou discovery | 190 passed |
| Architecture scanner | 431 of 673 files checked with zero findings and three existing size warnings |

2393.body:
## Problem

The nightly image job builds inside the HK cluster, where pip pulls every wheel from `pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn` (`PIP_INDEX` in the `digitalmate-image` job). Run 45099934169 spent 33 minutes in the pip layer before it was cancelled: the in-pod log and `/proc/net/dev` both measured ~69 kB/s, so single wheels took minutes (playwright 53.5 MB ≈ 12 min, faiss 19.5 MB ≈ 4 min, numpy 15.7 MB ≈ 3.5 min). A build log left on the cluster from 11-19 shows the same step at 12-57 MB/s, so the path, not the build, regressed. Historical image jobs on this workflow are 11.9-13.7 minutes.

## Measurement (from a pod in the same cluster, 53.5 MB wheel, two rounds)

| Index | Speed |
| --- | --- |
| tuna (current) | 69 / 89 kB/s |
| huawei | 6.4 MB/s / 31 MB/s |
| aliyun | 0.64 / 0.69 MB/s |
| tencent | 0.15 / 0.45 MB/s |
| ustc | 0.6 / 1.1 MB/s |
| pypi.org | 5.6 / 7.4 MB/s |

## Change

- `PIP_INDEX` -> `https://repo.huaweicloud.com/repository/pypi/simple`. The cluster runs on Huawei Cloud, so this avoids the international/cross-carrier path that degraded; `APT_MIRROR` and the build logic are unchanged.

## Verification

- Speeds measured from a cluster pod (table above); YAML parses.
- End-to-end timing is being verified by a Nightly dispatch from the release-branch twin of this change (#TBD), including a real-device E2E run.

2397.author: Jianyu010
2397.body:
Refs #2113.

## What this adds (decision AS-I29)

- **Tool result bounds** (`backend/host_api/tool_results.py`, `[host.tool_results]`): the Host is a second line behind the providers. Per-tool limits follow the providers that serve those names today, so a correctly bounded result passes byte for byte. Plain text over the limit stays plain text with a trailing notice. A JSON object over the whole-result limit (`max_result_chars = 120000`) loses its longest text values first and is flagged `host_truncated`. A provider's own `truncated` key is never overwritten. A binary value is never cut: it passes whole or is replaced by a notice. Bounding twice gives identical bytes. Content above `thread_above_chars` is bounded off the event loop.
- **Frame limits** (`[channel] max_frame_depth = 128`): checked on the raw bytes before the parse, in linear time, in both directions. The limits reach the Harness child through the environment and the Beebou entry validates them.
- **Run capacity** (`[backend] max_active_runs = 20`, old `engine_limits.py:31`): a slot is taken by a start in flight, a Run holding a Harness handle, and a released handle whose teardown is unconfirmed. Side Runs share the slots. At the limit B1 answers `HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE` before the Store is entered; queueing is Session Manager's.
- **Teardown confirmation**: a repeated `release` now reconciles in the real supervisor, and Backend confirms before refusing at the limit. A release that raises or is cancelled keeps the slot. A start cancelled during acquire keeps its slot until the acquire and its release finish.
- **Backend stop** waits up to its deadline for abandoned acquires and their releases; `BackendStopReport` gains optional `pending_acquires` and `pending_releases` (Backend inbound contract page updated).
- **Child process hygiene**: `supervisor.ready_seconds` back to the old 60 s; the last 20 per-run `process.log` files are kept under `<harness_root>/logs` (0700 directory, 0600 files, tail capped by `process_log_max_bytes`).

## Independent review

Two rounds by reviewers who did not write the code.

- **Round 1** found two must-fix defects: the result limits used the retired tools' numbers and cut results the live providers already bound (a 10-mail read came back as about two mails), and an unconfirmed-teardown slot was never freed by the real supervisor (the test passed only on the fake). Both fixed test-first, with ten should-fix items and four surviving mutants killed.
- **Round 2**, on the fix commits, found one must-fix: the new depth check was quadratic on an unterminated string of escaped quotes (16 s for an 80 KB invalid frame). Now linear: 0.04 s at 3 MB. Also fixed: binary values bypassing the per-tool limit, non-idempotent bounding below a minimum limit (now validated on load), a slow reduction loop on oversized JSON, Backend stop returning before abandoned starts finished, and the whole-result ceiling lowered from 262144 to 120000.

## Not in this PR

- Question option bounds and approval-card argument redaction (go with the question and approval card work).
- The child environment allow-list is unchanged.
- Leftover per-run work directories after a server crash are not cleaned (needs a new launch-record field); the log is not lost.

## For other owners

- **Session Manager:** queueing and the notice to the person when B1 answers `HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE` at the limit; Stop or retry of a start it cancelled, since such a Run keeps its slot while it holds a Harness.
- **Plugin Gateway providers** keep their own bounds; the Host is only the second line.
- **Main-first registration:** new file `backend/host_api/tool_results.py`; new public names `ToolResults`, `CHANNEL_FRAME_BYTES_ENV`, `CHANNEL_FRAME_DEPTH_ENV`, `ToolResultSettings`, `keep_process_log`.

No file under `session_store/`, `backend/session_manager/`, Delivery, Model Gateway or Plugin Gateway is edited.

## Gates on 32a48ba9f (contains 98c55d33e)

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Agent Service suite, run twice | 1916 tests, OK, 7 expected failures, both runs |
| Beebou | 192 tests, OK |
| Architecture | `checked 432 of 674 files`, no findings |
| Contract and enrollment | 92 passed, 1399 subtests |
